author: EncryptedShoesHD
body:
Hello there!

I am almost 100% sure all of you already know me, but let me introduce myself. My name is Tomaž (Call me Tom) and my surname is Bizjak (good luck pronouncing it). I am 16 years old and I am passionate about graphic design, programming and catching those pesky Avicus hackers. I've been playing on Avicus since 2014 (I guess) and I am still playing it, because of the community that keeps this server up. Although this server lost a lot of players, I still know there's a chance of reviving our beloved Avicus. Before I continue I would like to warn you that my English isn't that good when I have to write longer posts like this one, but it's better in conversations, so I hope you don't mind it. I guess that's enough for now, let's just continue with what I am supposed to write here xD.

Criteria:

  • Must have at least three days of play time. (Done, my play time is like 2 months.)

  • Must be applying for a moderator position. (What else would I want apply for?)

  • Must not be banned on any Avicus platform. (Not banned on any.)

  • Must speak fluent English (My English is decent, which most of you might already know...)

  • Must be active on all Avicus platforms (in-game, Teamspeak, Forums and Discord)  - (Well, I can't say I am active on TS, but I just came back so I am trying to be.)


Age: 16

Timezone: GMT +1 (I guess)

Do you have Teamspeak? Yes, I do.

Do you have Discord? Yes, I do.

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes, I do.

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a moderator on other servers?

  • Sure I do. I used to be a moderator on Avicus, but as you may know, I retired like 2 or 3 times, because of that crappy PC I used to have. Now I bought a better one, so my performance should be better now. I used to own a server, so I got some experience from there and I also used to be Admin on a few smaller servers.

What is your biggest weakness and how will it affect your moderating?

  • My biggest weakness is that I can be very stubborn. It should not affect Avicus in any way, but if it happens, I will make sure it doesn't happen again. I am also studying computer science (that's going to be my job) and typically school takes me a lot of time, so there might be days when I will be mostly inactive, but I will try to be active as much as possible.


What qualities do you think a leader must have? Would you consider yourself a leader? Why/why not?

  • I guess all leaders should be capable of dealing with all kinds of problems. Leader should always help their mates to perform at its best and leaders should never give up no matter what. I personally don't think I would consider myself as a leader, but I am capable of mantaining a good atmosphere and I am always ready to help, no matter what the problem is.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

  • Well, I am trying to be very active, but I don't think that's what matters the most. I am always trying to be nice and trying to be as helpful as possible. I am also fair to other people, so I rarely run into problems with them. Another thing I would like to mention is that I am always trying to give my best whenever I am working on something, so I guess that's something you guys are looking for.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

  • In my opinion, all staff members should be responsive, and they should also try to provide sufficient help to everyone. I also think that you should be able to accept critics/feedback peacefully, because critics teach us that we're doing something wrong, so we need to change things as soon as possible. 

What in your opinion are the three main character traits a moderator must have when moderating?

  • I think I mentioned all of them in the previous answers, but okay. A moderator should be responsive to any questions, feedback, critics, ideas, etc. All moderators are expected to be fair and should always listen to other people, because they might be right. The last thing that comes to my mind is that all staff members, no matter their position should be cooperative. Back when I used to be a moderator, I had problems with some staff members that did not want to cooperate with me (I am not exposing them), so I felt weird and bad at the same time.
CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS
You notice a moderator giving out a lot of false bans. They almost always have insufficient evidence or sometimes no evidence and they don’t seem to care. You notice it but other staff members don’t. What would you do?

  • Well, I would gather all the evidence and then step up to Administrators. In my opinion they are the ones who have a lot of experience, so they should be able to decide about further actions taken against that staff member. If Administrators would not care about the case, I would start a conversation with that specific staff member and tell them what they're doing wrong. Since a staff member should care about these things, I expect him to listen and improve stuff he's been doing wrong. If case is not that important, I would simply switch the actions taken against him and would firstly talk to him and then contact administrators (if necessary).

You are in Teamspeak with a few other players and they begin talking quite disrespectfully about a particular staff member. You agree with what they’re saying to an extent, but the conversation starts to become racial and very disrespectful soon after. You are all in a nightclub channel where this is allowed. What would you do?

  • Since it's allowed in nightclub channel, I can't do much about it. I would simply tell them that this is getting quite disrespectful and ask them if we can talk about anything else. By the way, I really hate those people who keep talking bad stuff about a specific person. I might also ask them to tell me why they think like that.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

  • Depends on what's been posted. If it was something about server updates or voting players for a JR trial, I would just ask him to delete the screenshot, since it's meant to be hiden from other users. If that member kept leaking private posts, I would most likely step up to a higher staff to let them know what's going on.

Some senior staff members are in teamspeak joking around with each other. They are removing others ranks, creating certain channels and even harassing certain users. They don’t mean any harm but some players in the channel feel a bit angry that they are using their permissions the way they are. What would you do?

  • Well, I don't think any senior staff member would do that since they all worked hard to get to that position. In case it really happens, I would talk to them firstly and ask them what's the problem. If they would not stop, I would contact administrators, since they are the ones who are responsible for keeping a good relationship between staff team and Avicus players.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.



Why do you want to be a moderator?


  • I want to be a moderator, because I know what it's like when there's no staff member online and players are looking for help. I am trying to be as active as possible and that's really important. I also think that Avicus is finally getting new players, so staff team will definitely need some help. I used to be a staff member on Avicus and I must say that I kind of got addicted to it xD.

What does Avicus mean to you?


  • It means a lot to me and I am proud to be a part of this awesome community. After good 3 years I still don't have any serious punishments, so you can see that I am being loyal to Avicus. If you don't agree with that I just said, I don't care, Avicus is the server I enjoy playing.


Anything specific the staff team could do better?


  • Well yeah, there are some things the staff team could do better. For example, they could improve their activity (this does not apply to all staff members, but it does apply to some of them) and keep track of quality of each staff member.

Why did you choose to apply at Avicus?


  • I chose to apply at Avicus, because I simply love it. I used to be a moderator for 2 times, but I am back and I will try to be as efficient as possible. I know that Avicus will expand one day, so I think we will need quality staff members.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?


  • Yes, my hands hurt, but I am proud of what you guys managed to do while I was away. I hope I will be accepted to an interview. By the way, I still do not have a microphone, but I will try to purchase one as soon as possible.
